P052.title: Development of a model for stochastic analysis of vehicle–track interaction considering spatial variability of track parameters
P052.label: Liu等（2023）

complete_examples.text: Ignoring the spatial correlation of random variables might underestimate the performance of the track system.

Herein, we regard the structural parameters as the random field in the spatial domain, and thereby the random field expansion method is employed to characterize the randomness and spatial correlation of representative track parameters, which effectively avoids the curse of dimensionality in parametric simulation.
